decided: A program counts as signed whenever the user's latest signature covers exactly the text of the latest saved brief, even a signature written with the sign-off command outside the architect session's question before the program's closing review, which names no closing review; the specs now say so as a known limit.
alternatives: count a signature only when it was given after the closing review, so such a signature, written before that review, asks the user again
why: The user chose it: the signature proves they read exactly this text, and the architect session itself asks only after the closing review, so only a signature written outside its question reaches this case.
